topic: Investigating data drop in analytics box
summary_markdown: Someone requested a check on a specific analytics box (001e422c9172) for the period of August 23rd to 25th due to a significant drop in data. It was confirmed that no changes were made to calibration or category settings. The data showed an abrupt, absolute decline starting at 7 AM UTC on August 24th, suggesting a potential physical issue like an antenna failure or the box being misplaced.
decisions: No changes were found in calibration or categories for the specified period.
action_items: Someone needs to send someone to physically inspect the location/equipment related to the data drop.
